notes: Delete of a derived fact: each world forgets one premise. The rule 'a place in a city is in the city's region' is the transitivity of located_in, so it is not a separate background item. q1 ('the same region as Marseille') is a join over named individuals; Marseille in Provence-Alpes-Côte d'Azur is its bridge (firm). queries.find: promenade : located_in some (City and located_in value ?)

queries.ask: promenade : located_in some (Region and inv(located_in) value marseille)

fol.notes: Places are an uninterpreted sort; located_in and being a city or a region are beliefs (uninterpreted predicates). The rule 'a place in a city is in the region the city is in' is firm (in the DL file it is the transitivity of located_in). Marseille being in Provence-Alpes-Côte d'Azur is the stored bridge. 'The same region' is a shared region (an existential over places). Fact ids and gives_up are the DL file's.

region_rule.says: A place in a city is in the region that the city is in.
region_rule.z3: ForAll([b, c, r], Implies(And(located_in(b, c), city(c), located_in(c, r), region(r)), located_in(b, r)))

queries.ask: Exists(r, And(region(r), located_in(promenade, r), located_in(marseille, r)))
